horizon: First 12 months from implementation under 2026 conditions; 365.25 days per model year
status: Calibrated model with explicit priors; not causal measurement

shared_inputs.name: raw_compute_log_growth
shared_inputs.rationale: Historical4-5x central; expanded structural forecast range, not a reported confidence interval.

shared_inputs.name: algorithmic_log_growth
shared_inputs.rationale: Central modern estimate; bounds deliberately span historical and broader-stack estimates. Includes data/recipe improvements: do not add them again.

shared_inputs.name: research_input_log_growth
shared_inputs.rationale: Anchors balanced-growth normalization; input-price deflated effective effort, not dollar-spending growth.

shared_inputs.name: research_flow_elasticity
shared_inputs.rationale: Diminishing parallelization returns; sources identify long-run lambda/beta more readily than lambda itself. Mode is a judgment, not measured.

shared_inputs.name: research_labor_share
shared_inputs.rationale: Uses cited .67 labor elasticity as weak anchor with broad transport range; compute gets complement1-share.

shared_inputs.name: feedback_to_research
shared_inputs.rationale: Upper support near .09 productivity/ECI times6.5ECI/logcompute; mode discounts self-report and labor-to-whole-R&D transport. Model feedback dynamically, never multiply by1/(1-rho).

shared_inputs.name: horizon_days
shared_inputs.rationale: User-selected first 12 months, normalized to 365.25 days.

shared_formula.capability_coordinate: x=log effective compute; baseline x0(t)=(gC+gA)*t, t in years
shared_formula.research_ode: Let a=log(A_policy/A_base), c=direct input/data log-equivalent-compute effect. beta=lambda*gR/gA. da/dt=gA*(exp(lambda*(log(resource_R)+eta*(a+c))-beta*a)-1).
shared_formula.effect: x_policy-x0=a+c; descriptive baseline-progress-equivalent days=-(a+c)/(gC+gA)*365.25. Exact milestone delays require solving policytrajectory(q*) and are not this number for slope-changingpolicies.
shared_formula.double_counting: resource_R is the first-order input bundle ratio, eta applies model-productivity feedback once, and gA already incorporates data/algorithm efficiency. Do not add historical algorithm share again.
shared_formula.limits: Local representative frontier, not fitted national portfolio maxima, China, relocation, security benefits, or welfare. Common shocks are shared across policies. Applying the representative-lab effect nationally assumes the marginal U.S. frontier remains exposed; laboratory switching is not estimated here.

policies.mechanism: Persistent input-level diversion plus dynamic effect on algorithmic R&D

inputs.name: baseline_safety_share
inputs.rationale: Observed6% compute anchors mode; wider range for other labs, salaries and less conservative definitions.

inputs.name: mandated_safety_share
inputs.rationale: Specified policy.

inputs.name: safety_capability_cobenefit
inputs.units: relative capability productivity of safety dollar
inputs.rationale: Safety can improve reliability, tools and safe usable capabilities; not all spending contributes to measured frontier.

inputs.name: budget_expansion
inputs.rationale: Marginal capital response over one year; allows partial offset without assuming unlimited fundraising.

inputs.name: implementation_ramp_days
inputs.rationale: Organizational reallocation ramps linearly; not a legal grace-period assertion.

policies.narrative: Apply equal proportional input ratio to direct production training and the separate research-input bundle. Budget and safety overlap apply once. The direct compute term is a lasting level shift; algorithmic feedback is integrated separately. A one-third total-budget rule is interpreted as covering compute and staff with proportional effective reallocation; alternate allocation optimization should be a sensitivity.

policies.mechanism: Older-model fallback during marginal evaluation gates

inputs.name: incremental_gate_days
inputs.rationale: Standard tests1-2weeks; zero for existing/overlapped gates, upper adds safeguards. Increment over voluntary practice.

inputs.name: model_generation_days
inputs.rationale: Effective internally useful upgrades; not count of every public API variant.

inputs.name: research_work_exposure
inputs.rationale: >90%AI collaboration at one lab suggests broad usage; newest model affects less than all work.

inputs.name: new_model_incremental_uplift
inputs.units: productivity gain vs previous available model
inputs.rationale: Much less than4x versus noAI; no direct randomized newest-versus-previous effect.

inputs.name: implementation_ramp_days
inputs.rationale: Rule and evaluator capacity phase in over first quarter.

policies.narrative: No direct training or public-release stop is imposed. Foregone incremental productivity feeds the shared R&D equation. Gate overlap is already in gate_days; do not discount overlap again. Generation-average exposure avoids mechanically adding the full gate once per model.

policies.mechanism: Additional human checkpoints plus foregone fully autonomous task chains

inputs.name: current_ai_leads_share
inputs.rationale: 26% at Anthropic, wide industry/sample transport interval.

inputs.name: endyear_ai_leads_share
inputs.rationale: Forward adoption judgment; current0.26 is not frozen through the year.

inputs.name: endyear_fully_autonomous_share
inputs.rationale: Starts zero; prospective uptake grows linearly. This is an adoption forecast, not a claim of existing full automation.

inputs.name: incremental_checkpoint_share
inputs.units: fraction eligible chains receiving an additional checkpoint
inputs.rationale: Many successful tasks already include human steering; only extra gates relative to voluntary practice count.

inputs.name: review_service_hours
inputs.rationale: Three to60minutes substantive service; measured lab service times unavailable.

inputs.name: reviewer_utilization
inputs.rationale: Staffing and batching keep mean below overload; tail models congestion.

inputs.name: handoff_hours
inputs.rationale: Context restoration and handoff in addition to queue service.

inputs.name: autonomous_cycle_hours
inputs.rationale: Observed reporting includes4-8hour tasks; broad range for experiments and agent chains.

inputs.name: autonomy_uplift_over_supervised
inputs.rationale: Gain specifically attributable to removing human dependencies, not overallAI uplift.

inputs.name: implementation_ramp_days
inputs.rationale: Incremental controls phase in.

policies.formula: review=service/(1-utilization)+handoff [M/M/1]; h=review/(cycle+review); s4(t)=linear(start,end), s5(t)=t*end5; Lloss=s4*additional*h+s5*u_aut/(1+u_aut); resource_R=(1-ramp*Lloss)^labor_share.
policies.narrative: AI-leads and fully autonomous shares are kept disjoint by capping s4 at1-s5. Review queue is an illustrative adapted operation, not an empirically fitted queue. Required human approval is per meaningful experiment/chain, not every token or tool call. Worst-case near-overload is a sensitivity, not baseline.

policies.mechanism: Fixed per-run scale ceiling with substitution and experiment bottlenecks

inputs.name: cap_headroom_log
inputs.rationale: Ceiling about current largest run, with measurement/implementation headroom.

inputs.name: binding_compliance
inputs.rationale: High-enforcement domestic policy; not global coverage.

inputs.name: scale_gap_recovered_other_channels
inputs.rationale: Post-training/inference/ensembles offset some capability loss; compute redeployment85% is not reused as capability recovery.

inputs.name: frontier_scale_dependent_experiments
inputs.rationale: Most experiments are not final frontier training; a material share nevertheless needs frontier-relevant scale.

inputs.name: blocked_compute_redeployed
inputs.rationale: 85% measured short-run offset anchors mode; transport from one restriction is uncertain.

inputs.name: substitute_experiment_value
inputs.rationale: Quantity of reused compute is not value of the research it enables.

policies.narrative: Ceiling applies to training-run compute, not all national compute, inference or every small experiment. Cap-driven direct scaling loss and remaining experimental-research losses are separate. The algorithmic baseline already includes historical scale-dependent progress: the resource penalty is only its marginal response to the cap, not another entire attribution share.

policies.mechanism: Six-month interruption with continued permitted research and post-pause catch-up

inputs.name: pause_days
inputs.rationale: Exactly half of a 365.25-day model year; no indefinite extension.

inputs.name: permitted_progress_offset
inputs.rationale: Post-training/inference and below-threshold methods remain permitted as described on menu.

inputs.name: scale_gap_recovered_by_yearend
inputs.rationale: Hardware and recipes accumulate; restarting permits partial catch-up. Six-month recovery evidence is absent.

inputs.name: blocked_research_compute_share
inputs.rationale: Training ban affects scale-validation more than all below-threshold experiments.

inputs.name: blocked_compute_redeployed
inputs.rationale: Short-run observed85% offset anchors uncertain transfer.

inputs.name: substitute_experiment_value
inputs.rationale: Permitted work does not necessarily produce equivalent frontier-relevant discoveries.

policies.formula: P=pause_days/365.25; k=-ln(1-catchup)/(1-P). While paused: c(t)=-gC*t*(1-offset), R=[1-blocked_share*(1-redeploy*value)]^(1-labor_share). After pause: c(t)=-gC*P*(1-offset)*exp(-k*(t-P)), R=1. Recovery continues exponentially beyond year 1.
policies.narrative: No China pause assumed here; parent handles foreign response. Includes only incremental statutory interruption relative to same voluntary baseline. Endpoint 12-month displacement differs from maximum displacement during the pause. After year 1 the direct residual continues to recover exponentially at the same fitted recovery rate; it is not charged again yearly. That continuation is a sensitivity assumption, not evidence about three-year recovery.

policies.mechanism: Data-mixture substitution, licensing cost and critical-path transition

inputs.name: data_needing_new_permission
inputs.rationale: Unknown proprietary mixtures; copyright and personal-data scope potentially broad.

inputs.name: affected_data_recovered
inputs.rationale: Allowed corpora and contracts offer substitutes; frontier/domain coverage uncertain.

inputs.name: replacement_quality
inputs.rationale: Allows slightly better curated replacements; not equating token count to useful information.

inputs.name: baseline_epochs
inputs.rationale: Public recipes vary; repeat-data response conditions on baseline usage.

inputs.name: repeat_data_saturation
inputs.rationale: Published fitted mode, deliberately broadened for transport; not published confidence interval.

inputs.name: parameter_saturation
inputs.rationale: Published fitted mode with structural transport uncertainty.

inputs.name: loss_exponent
inputs.rationale: Equalized parameter/data exponents around studyfit for normalized toy model; task transport uncertain.

inputs.name: pretraining_dependency
inputs.units: share effective-compute penalty that carries to target frontier
inputs.rationale: Downstream/post-training substitution may absorb part of pretraining-loss penalty.

inputs.name: licensing_budget_share
inputs.rationale: Incremental recurring licensing and provenance costs; genericbudgetprior, not a measured licensingprice.

inputs.name: transition_days
inputs.rationale: A bounded one-time licensing/filtering/pipeline transition; not automatic retraining of existing models.

inputs.name: transition_critical_share
inputs.rationale: Most bargaining and preparation can overlap; no one-for-one elapsed-days assumption.

inputs.name: transition_gap_remaining
inputs.rationale: Allows recovery of a one-time schedule disturbance.

policies.formula: uData=1-m+m*recovered*quality. Optimize N,D with N*D=1 at U=uData/baseline_epochs using effective-token/parameter saturation. logC_data=-(2/alpha)*log(L_policy/L_base)*dependency. Let h(t)=min(1,t*365.25/transition), z(t)=min(1,max(0,(t-transition/365.25)/(1-transition/365.25))). delay(t)=transition*critical*h(t)*(1-(1-remaining)*z(t)); c(t)=h(t)*(logC_data+ln(1-budget))-gTotal*delay(t)/365.25; R(t)=1-h(t)*budget.
policies.narrative: Data ratio changes quality-adjusted unique tokens; repeated tokens and excess parameters follow fitted saturation functions. Equal-budget minimization captures recipe adaptation. The data penalty is a level term and already includes existing repetition; do not impose an extra raw-token penalty. Recurring budget loss applies once to direct training and once to distinct research inputs. No retroactive destruction/retraining required.

rsi2026.title: Cunningham et al., The Economics of Recursive Self-Improvement
rsi2026.evidence: Calibration uses algorithmic and research-input growth near ln(3)/year; approximately 6.5 ECI per log effective compute. Reported labor-task uplift implies a rough upper-ish 0.09 log productivity/ECI, explicitly uncertain; this is not aggregate R&D productivity.

slowdown2025.title: Whitfill, Snodin and Becker, Forecasting AI Time Horizon Under Compute Slowdowns
slowdown2025.evidence: Algorithmic log growth estimate 1.265/year, 95% interval .667-3.614. Appendix C cites labor exponent .67 and long-run research return .95; time-horizon/effective-compute exponent .454. Compute-bottleneck mechanism is assumed, not established by two model families.

anthropic_allocation.title: Anthropic, Measurements for understanding the pace of AI development inside frontier labs
anthropic_allocation.evidence: July13-20: safety 6% of AI-R&D compute, 12% of AI-driven AI-R&D compute; conservative definition excludes equally dual-use work. August: AI leads26%, collaborates-or-higher>90%, measured fully autonomous0%. One-lab, one-week compute snapshot and model-assisted classification.

openai_acceleration.title: OpenAI, Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
openai_acceleration.evidence: August7 model-specific restrictions: Astra-class GPU allocation fell59.2%; other classes rose17.2%, offsetting about85% of decline. July20 incident included two-week RL pause. Over half successful4-8h tasks already had human intervention. Redeployed compute does not measure recovered research value.

anthropic_uplift.title: Anthropic, When AI builds itself
anthropic_uplift.evidence: March survey of130 employees: median4x self-reported output with Mythos versus no AI; authors expect true uplift lower. Human review and research direction remain bottlenecks. This is not the incremental uplift of the newest versus previous model.

epoch_compute.title: Sevilla and Roldan, Training compute of frontier AI models grows by4-5x per year
epoch_compute.evidence: Historical recommendation4-5x/year; frontier post2018 estimate4.2x,90%CI3.6-4.9; frontier language-model trend5x,90%CI3.1-7.3. Future range must allow structural breaks.

epoch_software.title: Anson Ho, The least understood driver of AI progress
epoch_software.evidence: Synthesizes mostly-pretraining estimates around3x,6x, and10x/year with very broad uncertainty; stresses data quality, distillation and scale dependence. Informal primary-author methodological discussion, not an additional independent sample.

epoch_compute_share.title: Denain and Wu, Final training runs account for a minority of R&D compute spending
epoch_compute_share.evidence: OpenAI2024 estimate: about10% of R&D compute spend in final released-model training; remaining workloads include experiments and synthetic data. Final-run share is not the share of capability progress attributable to scale.

scale_dependence.title: Gundlach et al., On the Origin of Algorithmic Progress in AI
scale_dependence.evidence: Ablations and scaling experiments find substantial compute-scale dependence of algorithmic gains. Supports a nonzero cap/experiment bottleneck prior, not its numerical mode.

chaining2026.title: Demirer et al., Chaining Tasks, Redefining Work
chaining2026.evidence: Models nonlinear gains from contiguous AI task chains and handoff costs. Supplies mechanism, no frontier-lab service-time estimate.

aisi.title: AISI, Early lessons from evaluating frontier AI systems
aisi.evidence: Standard evaluation tier can complete in1-2weeks; light tier QA/reporting1-2weeks. Elevated investigations may take longer; proxy models/preparation can overlap. These are durations, not incremental research delays.

data_scaling.title: Muennighoff et al., Scaling Data-Constrained Language Models
data_scaling.evidence: 182-run parametric fit: repeated-token saturation R_D=15.3878, excess-parameter R_N=5.3097, exponents≈.353, fittedR2=.781. Full project400runs up to9B parameters. Transport to2026 frontier is unvalidated.

commonpile.title: Kandpal et al., The Common Pile v0.1
commonpile.evidence: Openly licensed8TB corpus;7B models trained on1T/2Ttokens competitive with similarly budgeted Llama1/2. Establishes credible substitutes, not frontier parity or the fraction of present data licensable.

menu.title: AI Safety Menu policy definitions
menu.locator: Backing info pages and local work/policy-audit/data.js
menu.evidence: Defines the six hypothetical requirements; prior menu prices are not used as calibration targets.
